verdict.rationale: Snyk documents an official SDK, but only a narrow one for writing, testing, bundling and distributing custom IaC rules in Rego for the Snyk IaC CLI. No general-purpose language SDKs or API client libraries for building against the Snyk platform are evidenced, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404. Missing for 10: general-purpose official SDKs (e.g. Python/JS/Go clients for the Snyk API), a published OpenAPI spec for SDK generation, SDK coverage beyond IaC custom rules, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The SDK helps you write, debug, test, bundle, and distribute custom rules written in Rego, which can then be used by the Snyk IaC CLI to find vulnerabilities in IaC configuration files.
Install the SDK using one of these options
once you have generated your custom rules bundle, you can distribute it automatically to one of our supported OCI registries by using the `push` command
